objective.primary_question: Does the integrated harness correctly produce and display legacy regression verdict, quote-integrity telemetry, structural-evidence telemetry, and combined telemetry on two fresh controlled reports without altering legacy verdict or process exit?
objective.phase_3_type: controlled A/B integration validation on Phase 2 harness
objective.phase_3_scope: integration correctness on the emitted telemetry paths — NOT a model-quality benchmark

run_count.notes: Exactly two paid generations, one per fixture, no retries.

A.role: primary — Backend engineer → Applied AI pivot

prereq_dev_server.run_in: separate terminal / background before invoking harness
prereq_dev_server.must_be_ready: wait for `Ready in Xms` line before Run A

run_A.expected_process_exit: 0 (green) or 2 (amber) or 1 (red) — driven solely by classify(legacy checks)
run_A.structural_telemetry: automatically enabled since Phase 2 (bc246d3 · f7710b6) landed on main

run_B.note: Only run B after A completes successfully AND after checking stop conditions.

cost_envelope.provider: existing approved Anthropic API path via app runtime (Sonnet 4.6)
cost_envelope.action_on_cap_exceeded: stop · report actual usage · do NOT continue to B · do NOT retry
cost_envelope.cost_measurement_source: runtime cost accounting emitted by the existing app path where available; otherwise external ledger entry with justification

stop_conditions: stop after A if generation completion_state !== 'success' AND cause is external (provider outage, browser crash) — B would not add new signal
stop after A if harness legacy checks[] shape changed
stop after A if structural result appears in classify() input checks[]
stop after A if process.exit(classification.exit) semantics changed
stop after A if baseline files under .agent/regression_baselines/** changed
stop after A if the validator or QI rewrites the captured report.md
stop after A if unexpected paid retry begins (any auto-retry)
stop after A if measured cost exceeds hard_cap_per_run (0.075 USD)
stop after A if measured cost + projected B cost exceeds hard_cap_total (0.15 USD)
stop after A if provider returns 4xx/5xx with paid metering AND cost accounting cannot confirm sub-cap
stop after A if structural summary schema fails validation
stop after A if metadata.combined_telemetry field is missing or malformed
stop after B if any of the above triggers after B completes (still stop; do NOT retry)
stop immediately if ANY forbidden file changes (src/**, prompts, QI checker, baselines, .agent/scripts/**, package/lock/workflow/env/vercel, pipeline)

must contain four sibling sections: Legacy · QI · Structural · Combined
legacy 25-check list only — MUST NOT include structural evidence entries
scratchpad ONLY — MUST NOT be committed
scratchpad ONLY — MUST NOT be committed

policy_resolutions.Q1_paid_run_count: 2 (exactly one Fixture A + one Fixture B)
policy_resolutions.Q2_fixtures: A and B — no C/D/E, no additional fixtures
policy_resolutions.Q3_retry_allowed: NO — zero automatic or manual retry
policy_resolutions.Q7_exact_commands: node scripts/report-regression-local.mjs --fixture A · then B · with npm run dev in a separate terminal
policy_resolutions.Q9_does_structural_red_fail_phase3: NO — a structural RED that accurately reflects the generated report AND does not alter legacy verdict/process exit is not an integration failure; it is a valid telemetry observation. Product-quality follow-up may be triggered separately.
policy_resolutions.Q11_does_telemetry_affect_legacy_verdict: NO — invariant asserted by tests I17/I20 and verified in run artifacts
policy_resolutions.Q12_does_telemetry_affect_process_exit: NO — process.exit(classification.exit) remains the sole authority
policy_resolutions.Q14_are_reports_rewritten: NO — validator and helper never mutate report.md
policy_resolutions.Q15_are_run_artifacts_committed: YES for 7 governance artifacts per run · NO for report.md and screenshot (scratchpad only)
policy_resolutions.Q16_does_phase3_authorize_phase4: NO — Phase 4 (baseline metadata migration) requires separate DECISION + grandfathering policy
policy_resolutions.Q17_does_phase3_authorize_blocking_promo: NO — Phase 6 requires separate DECISION and additional evidence phases
policy_resolutions.Q19_what_if_A_fails_externally: record failure · do NOT retry A · do NOT run B · report cost incurred · Phase 3 result = 'pause' unless issue is fully within our runtime, in which case = 'revise'
policy_resolutions.Q20_what_if_cost_exceeds_cap: stop immediately · do NOT continue to B · do NOT retry · surface actual usage · Phase 3 DECISION outcome = 'revise' or 'pause' with explicit cost explanation

risks: External provider (Anthropic API) outage or 429 could inflate wall clock without producing telemetry — mitigated by 240s HARD_LATENCY_MS and stop-on-external-failure
Dev server not started before harness — hard-rejected by assertLocalhost; harness fails deterministically without paid call
Capture context derivation regression from run_07 fix could re-emerge if Phase 2 code is silently touched — mitigated by re-running deterministic 66/66 suite before + after Phase 3
Structural evidence RED on a real generated report could be misread as an integration failure — mitigated by memo § 18 distinguishing product from integration failure
Cost accounting granularity varies by provider path — mitigated by hard_cap_per_run + hard_cap_total
Legacy 25-check count could drift if any script is silently edited — Phase 3 RUN_REPORT MUST record the count from structural_checks.json for direct comparison against Phase 2 baseline
Combined telemetry precedence could be misread by future consumers — mitigated by memo § 16 explicit table and by metadata.combined_telemetry.display_only field

Retention leak risk: report.md accidentally committed — mitigated by .agent/regression_runs/<run-id>/ containing only sanitized JSON + verdict.md; report.md path is $TMPDIR/acr-regression-runs/<run-id>/
Baseline eligibility could unintentionally shift if metadata schema is over-interpreted — mitigated by no-promotion policy and by 0-line baseline diff acceptance criterion
Design scope creep: 'while we're at it' quality tuning — explicitly forbidden by TASK and design memo § 4/§ 5
